title: Trying clarinet and trumpet, then the marching band and club dances
summary: Humes quit clarinet and trumpet quickly and stayed with singing and piano. Miss Bess took her marching band to fairs, and at night Humes played piano and sang at the dance, where the band played popular songs and jazz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Yeah. So you'd go to the Sun School because you knew it was a music thing and everybody got to play?

Yeah, and I decided I wanted to play the clarinet because some friends of mine, some girls, they were playing the clarinet and I said, I want to play the clarinet too. And I started out and I learned how to play the scales and what have you but I just couldn't stand playing that thing so I put that down. And then I took up the trumpet. Well I learned how to play the scales and blow one or two little things and then I put that down. I said, I don't want to be bothered with that. So I just said, well I'll just stick to singing and playing the piano. And she used to have this big band, you know, the Marching Band, and they'd do, you know, like they'd have little afairs and things, you know. Miss Bess always took the band to the fair and everything. And then at night when they would have the little club, that's where I'd come in because I'd play the piano and I would sing, you know. That's a dance, you know, at night. So that's where I came in.
